data.one_liner: Retrieve Android and iOS launch arguments inside a Flutter app.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that allows applications to retrieve launch arguments passed via platform-specific commands or tools like instrumentation tests. It provides methods to fetch strings, booleans, doubles, and integers as futures.
use_when: You need to pass configuration or arguments to your app when launching instrumentation tests.
You want to retrieve launch arguments on both Android and iOS that are not limited to runtime --dart-define parameters.
avoid_when: You only need standard compile-time constants like --dart-define.
You need complex inter-app communication beyond simple launch arguments.
strengths: Simple API to fetch various primitive data types (string, bool, double, int).
Supports both Android and iOS platform launch arguments.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific commands or tooling (such as adb or simctl) to inject arguments upon launch.
